description: This file contains the implementation of REST API endpoints for team management operations within a FastAPI application. It includes classes and functions for creating, updating, and managing teams and team members, handling role-based permissions, validating limits against organization and user constraints, and auditing. The file interacts with a database via Prisma, manages object permissions, and supports features like budget management, permission checks, and audit logs.
